title: Aim2Balance
tagline: AI-integrated health and wellness platform forked from LibreChat
description: Customised LibreChat into a specialised health platform. Built domain-specific AI agents, integrated wellness tracking, designed the auth and privacy model, and shipped a production-grade product real patients use weekly.
pullQuote: We forked an open-source chat platform, then bent it into a clinical product without breaking a single user.

title: Roofcast
tagline: Real estate analytics and forecasting tool
description: A data-driven platform forecasting property values across the Netherlands. Ingests fourteen sources nightly, normalises, scores, and presents — without a single chart that takes more than two seconds to read.
pullQuote: A house has a thousand inputs. We turned them into one number a buyer can act on.

title: JEOfferte
tagline: E-commerce offer and quotation management system
description: An offer and quotation management system for Dutch SMEs. Replaced a tangle of spreadsheets and inbox threads with a single source of truth — quotes, invoices, client comms, all in one workflow.
pullQuote: Quotes used to take three emails and a phone call. Now they take ninety seconds.
